description: This file implements the 'git difftool' command, providing functionality to compare differences between files and directories using external diff tools. It handles various configurations, processes index and working directory states, supports directory diffs, symlinks, submodules, and manages invocation of external diff tools as subprocesses.

methods.name: int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures difftool options based on git config variables, enabling trust_exit_code and symlinks settings.

methods.name: int print_tool_help(void)
methods.description: Displays help information about available difftool commands and tools.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses a line describing index state and object IDs, updating mode and object ID variables.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Appends a relative path to a strbuf, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on current state.

methods.name: int working_tree_entry_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for working tree entries, based on file path.

methods.name: int pair_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for pair entries, based on file path.

methods.name: void add_left_or_right(struct hashmap * map,const char * path,const char * content,int is_right)
methods.description: Adds a left or right side content to a hashmap for directory diff representations.

methods.name: int path_entry_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * key)
methods.description: Comparison function for path entries in hashmaps.

methods.name: void changed_files(struct repository * repo,struct hashmap * result,const char * index_path,const char * workdir)
methods.description: Updates a hashmap with files that have changes by invoking underlying git commands.

methods.name: int ensure_leading_directories(struct repository * repo,char * path)
methods.description: Creates leading directories for a given path, handling errors.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves symlink contents or object data for a path, respecting symlink options.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Checks out a file from an object ID into the work directory.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes content to a file in a specified directory, creating leading directories as needed.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Creates temporary stand-in files for submodules and symlinks for directory diffing.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Performs directory diff using the specified external tool, handling setup, running, and cleanup.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Runs a diff command on individual files, with environment setup for external diff tools.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function invoked to execute 'git difftool', parsing options, configuring environment, and dispatching to directory or file diff functions.
